name: SG90 micro servo (9 g)
description: Tiny plastic-gear servo, about 1.8 kg.cm at 4.8 V. For light loads only.
notes: Wire colours: brown (or black) = GND, red = V+, orange (or yellow / white) = signal. 3-pin 2.54 mm female plug.
Supply 4.8-6 V. Budget the stall (peak) current for every servo that can stall at the same time.
Power servos from a separate supply (not the microcontroller 5V/3V3 pin) and join the grounds.
Stall current is not in the TowerPro datasheet; measured values are about 0.5-0.75 A at 5 V. 0.7 A is used here.
Many clones exist; some are rated 4.8-6 V, a few say up to 7.2 V. Use 6 V max unless your datasheet says otherwise.
Size with mounting tabs: 32.3 x 12.2 mm, body 22.5 mm long, 31 mm tall incl. shaft.

pins.name: SIG
pins.label: signal (orange)
pins.note: 50 Hz pulses, about 0.5-2.5 ms. 3.3 V and 5 V logic both work on most servos.

mechanical.side_load: low: add a bearing for any bending load
mechanical.source: TowerPro SG90 datasheet: 1.8 kgf·cm at 4.8 V, 0.1 s/60°, 9 g, dead band 10 µs
